```{r}
base_dir <- "C:/Users/Apu/Desktop/asl/rstudio files/seminar/project1/data"

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "adrv_combined")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Find only yearly ADRV sport-total files
adrv_files <- list.files(
  path = base_dir,
  pattern = "wada_adrv_[0-9]{4}_sport_totals\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

get_year_from_file <- function(x) {
  as.integer(str_extract(basename(x), "[0-9]{4}"))
}

adrv_files <- adrv_files[order(get_year_from_file(adrv_files))]

print(adrv_files)

if (length(adrv_files) != 8) {
  warning("Expected 8 ADRV sport-total files, but found ", length(adrv_files))
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_number <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("−", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("–", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("—", "-") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    na_if("") %>%
    na_if("-") %>%
    as.numeric()
}

coalesce_chr_cols <- function(data, cols) {
  existing_cols <- intersect(cols, names(data))
  
  if (length(existing_cols) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(data)))
  }
  
  values <- map(existing_cols, ~ as.character(data[[.x]]))
  do.call(coalesce, values)
}

coalesce_num_cols <- function(data, cols) {
  existing_cols <- intersect(cols, names(data))
  
  if (length(existing_cols) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))
  }
  
  values <- map(existing_cols, ~ clean_number(data[[.x]]))
  do.call(coalesce, values)
}

sum_num_cols <- function(data, cols) {
  existing_cols <- intersect(cols, names(data))
  
  if (length(existing_cols) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))
  }
  
  mat <- map_dfc(existing_cols, ~ tibble(value = clean_number(data[[.x]])))
  out <- rowSums(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  all_missing <- rowSums(!is.na(mat)) == 0
  out[all_missing] <- NA_real_
  out
}
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Read and combine raw files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_adrv_raw_with_source <- map_dfr(
  adrv_files,
  function(file_path) {
    read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      clean_names() %>%
      mutate(
        source_file = basename(file_path),
        source_year = get_year_from_file(file_path),
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

wada_adrv_raw_combined <- wada_adrv_raw_with_source %>%
  select(-source_file, -source_year)

write_csv(
  wada_adrv_raw_combined,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_raw_combined.csv")
)

write_csv(
  wada_adrv_raw_with_source,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_raw_combined_with_source.csv")
)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create standardized combined ADRV file
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_adrv_standardized <- wada_adrv_raw_with_source %>%
  mutate(
    year = clean_number(year),
    
    sport_category_sources = coalesce_chr_cols(
      cur_data(),
      c("sport_category_tables", "sport_group_tables", "sport_categories")
    ),
    
    source_tables_standardized = coalesce_chr_cols(
      cur_data(),
      c("source_tables", "sport_category_tables", "sport_group_tables")
    ),
    
    total_samples_aaf_outcome = coalesce_num_cols(
      cur_data(),
      c(
        "total_samples_aaf_table",
        "total_samples_aaf_outcome",
        "total_samples_reported_in_adrv_report"
      )
    ),
    
    aaf_outcome_total = clean_number(aaf_outcome_total),
    medical_reasons_count = clean_number(medical_reasons_count),
    no_case_to_answer_count = clean_number(no_case_to_answer_count),
    no_sanction_count = clean_number(no_sanction_count),
    pending_count = clean_number(pending_count),
    analytical_adrv_count = clean_number(analytical_adrv_count),
    
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated = coalesce_num_cols(
      cur_data(),
      c("non_analytical_adrv_count_athletes", "non_analytical_adrv_count")
    ),
    
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated = coalesce_num_cols(
      cur_data(),
      c("total_adrv_count_sport_allocated", "total_adrv_count")
    ),
    
    aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate = if_else(
      aaf_outcome_total > 0,
      analytical_adrv_count / aaf_outcome_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    analytical_adrv_detail_count = coalesce_num_cols(
      cur_data(),
      c(
        "analytical_adrv_detail_count",
        "analytical_adrv_detail_count_excluding_dbs",
        "analytical_adrv_detail_calc"
      )
    ),
    
    analytical_detail_vs_aaf_outcome_diff = case_when(
      !is.na(analytical_detail_vs_aaf_outcome_diff) ~ clean_number(analytical_detail_vs_aaf_outcome_diff),
      !is.na(analytical_adrv_detail_count) ~ analytical_adrv_detail_count - analytical_adrv_count,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    analytical_urine_ooc = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_urine_ooc")),
      sum_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_urine_ooc_male", "analytical_urine_ooc_female"))
    ),
    
    analytical_urine_ic = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_urine_ic")),
      sum_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_urine_ic_male", "analytical_urine_ic_female"))
    ),
    
    analytical_blood_ooc = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_blood_ooc")),
      sum_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_blood_ooc_male", "analytical_blood_ooc_female"))
    ),
    
    analytical_blood_ic = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_blood_ic")),
      sum_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_blood_ic_male", "analytical_blood_ic_female"))
    ),
    
    analytical_dbs_ooc = coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_dbs_ooc")),
    analytical_dbs_ic = coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_dbs_ic")),
    
    analytical_urine_total = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_urine_total")),
      analytical_urine_ooc + analytical_urine_ic
    ),
    
    analytical_blood_total = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_blood_total")),
      analytical_blood_ooc + analytical_blood_ic
    ),
    
    analytical_dbs_total = coalesce(
      coalesce_num_cols(cur_data(), c("analytical_dbs_total")),
      analytical_dbs_ooc + analytical_dbs_ic
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    adrv_share_sport_allocated = total_adrv_count_sport_allocated /
      sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    analytical_adrv_share = analytical_adrv_count /
      sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated =
      non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated /
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    source_file,
    source_year,
    year,
    sport_clean,
    sport_raw_sources,
    sport_category_sources,
    source_tables = source_tables_standardized,
    total_samples_aaf_outcome,
    aaf_outcome_total,
    medical_reasons_count,
    no_case_to_answer_count,
    no_sanction_count,
    pending_count,
    analytical_adrv_count,
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate,
    adrv_share_sport_allocated,
    analytical_adrv_share,
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated,
    any_of(c(
      "has_aaf_outcome_data",
      "has_non_analytical_adrv_data",
      "aaf_outcome_check"
    )),
    analytical_adrv_detail_count,
    analytical_detail_vs_aaf_outcome_diff,
    analytical_urine_ooc,
    analytical_urine_ic,
    analytical_urine_total,
    analytical_blood_ooc,
    analytical_blood_ic,
    analytical_blood_total,
    analytical_dbs_ooc,
    analytical_dbs_ic,
    analytical_dbs_total,
    source_report
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, desc(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated), sport_clean)

write_csv(
  wada_adrv_standardized,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_standardized_source_level.csv")
)
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validation summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

expected_year_totals <- tribble(
  ~year, ~official_aafs, ~official_analytical_adrvs, ~official_non_analytical_athlete_adrvs, ~asp_not_sport_allocated, ~official_total_adrvs_including_asp, ~note,
  2016, 3032, 1326, 248, 21, 1595, "Sport-allocated total excludes 21 ASP cases reported only by nationality.",
  2017, 2749, 1459, 317, 28, 1804, "Known 2-case inconsistency: detailed sport rows extract to 1,457 analytical ADRVs vs 1,459 official analytical ADRVs.",
  2018, 2771, 1640, 267, 16, 1923, "Sport-allocated total excludes 16 ASP cases; report has a small one-case wording inconsistency.",
  2019, 2701, 1537, 351, 26, 1914, "Sport-allocated total excludes 26 ASP cases reported only by nationality.",
  2020, 1010, 672, 238, 25, 935, "Uses detailed Section 1 AAF outcome total of 1,010.",
  2021, 1553, 1094, 262, 32, 1388, "Sport-allocated total excludes ASP cases; Executive Summary logic uses 32 ASP cases.",
  2022, 1979, 1376, 245, 31, 1652, "Sport-allocated total excludes 31 ASP cases reported only by nationality.",
  2023, 2301, 1654, 351, 0, 2005, "2023 Excel extraction uses sport-level pivot parent rows."
)

validation_summary <- wada_adrv_standardized %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    source_file = first(source_file),
    rows = n(),
    unique_sports = n_distinct(sport_clean),
    aaf_outcome_total = sum(aaf_outcome_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    medical_reasons_count = sum(medical_reasons_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    no_case_to_answer_count = sum(no_case_to_answer_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    no_sanction_count = sum(no_sanction_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    pending_count = sum(pending_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    analytical_adrv_count = sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated =
      sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    adrv_share_sum = sum(adrv_share_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    analytical_adrv_share_sum = sum(analytical_adrv_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sum =
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(expected_year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    combined_plus_asp = total_adrv_count_sport_allocated + asp_not_sport_allocated,
    aaf_diff_vs_official = aaf_outcome_total - official_aafs,
    analytical_diff_vs_official = analytical_adrv_count - official_analytical_adrvs,
    non_analytical_diff_vs_official =
      non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated -
      official_non_analytical_athlete_adrvs,
    combined_plus_asp_diff_vs_official_total =
      combined_plus_asp - official_total_adrvs_including_asp
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

write_csv(
  validation_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_combination_validation_summary.csv")
)

print(validation_summary)

cat("\nCombined ADRV files saved in:", out_dir, "\n")
cat("Rows in standardized file:", nrow(wada_adrv_standardized), "\n")
cat("Years:", paste(sort(unique(wada_adrv_standardized$year)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Project 1: Clean / harmonise WADA ADRV sport names
# Input:
#   1) wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_standardized_source_level_R.csv
#   2) wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_final_sport_names.csv
# Output:
#   A cleaned ADRV sport-year file ready to join with Testing Figures
# ============================================================

adrv_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "wada_adrv_sport_year_2016_2023_standardized_source_level_R.csv"
)

testing_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_final_sport_names.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "adrv_cleaned_for_testing_join")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(sort(x), collapse = " | ")
  }
}

sum_preserve_na <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

any_true <- function(x) {
  any(str_to_lower(as.character(x)) %in% c("true", "1", "yes"), na.rm = TRUE)
}

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Read data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

adrv <- read_csv(adrv_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    sport_clean_original = sport_clean
  )

testing <- read_csv(testing_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. General sport-name harmonisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

name_map <- c(
  "Billiards Sports" = "Billiards",
  "Canoe" = "Canoe / Kayak",
  "College Sports" = "College",
  "Fishing" = "Sport Fishing",
  "Horse Racing (R)" = "Horse Racing",
  "Motor Sport" = "Motorcycling",
  "Motorcycle Racing" = "Motorcycling",
  "ParaVolley" = "Sitting Volleyball",
  "Pole sports" = "Pole Sports",
  "Wheelchair Basketball" = "Basketball",
  "Wheelchair Tennis" = "Tennis",
  "Softball" = "Baseball / Softball"
)

adrv_harmonised <- adrv %>%
  mutate(
    sport_join_name = recode(
      sport_clean_original,
      !!!as.list(name_map),
      .default = sport_clean_original
    ),

    # Year-specific WADA wording changes between ADRV reports and Testing Figures.
    sport_join_name = case_when(
      sport_join_name == "Blind Football" & year == 2021 ~ "Football 5-a-Side",
      sport_join_name == "Blind Football" & year %in% c(2022, 2023) ~ "Football - IBSA Football",
      sport_join_name == "Kettlebell Lifting" & year == 2020 ~ "Kettlebell",
      sport_join_name == "Rugby League" & year == 2020 ~ "Rugby",
      sport_join_name == "Para-Biathlon" & year == 2017 ~ "Biathlon",
      sport_join_name == "Para-Cross Country Skiing" & year == 2019 ~ "Para-Nordic Skiing",
      sport_join_name == "Shooting Para Sport" & year == 2021 ~ "Shooting",
      TRUE ~ sport_join_name
    ),
    name_changed = sport_clean_original != sport_join_name
  )

# 2023 Unknown (ASP) is not a sport and should not be joined to Testing Figures.
adrv_excluded_non_sport <- adrv_harmonised %>%
  filter(sport_join_name == "Unknown (ASP)")

adrv_sport_only <- adrv_harmonised %>%
  filter(sport_join_name != "Unknown (ASP)")

```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Re-aggregate after harmonisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

adrv_cleaned <- adrv_sport_only %>%
  group_by(year, sport_join_name) %>%
  summarise(
    old_adrv_sport_names = collapse_unique(sport_clean_original),
    n_adrv_source_rows = n(),
    sport_raw_sources = collapse_unique(sport_raw_sources),
    sport_category_sources = collapse_unique(sport_category_sources),
    source_tables = collapse_unique(source_tables),
    total_samples_aaf_outcome = sum_preserve_na(total_samples_aaf_outcome),
    aaf_outcome_total = sum_preserve_na(aaf_outcome_total),
    medical_reasons_count = sum_preserve_na(medical_reasons_count),
    no_case_to_answer_count = sum_preserve_na(no_case_to_answer_count),
    no_sanction_count = sum_preserve_na(no_sanction_count),
    pending_count = sum_preserve_na(pending_count),
    analytical_adrv_count = sum_preserve_na(analytical_adrv_count),
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated = sum_preserve_na(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated),
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated = sum_preserve_na(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated),
    analytical_adrv_detail_count = sum_preserve_na(analytical_adrv_detail_count),
    analytical_urine_ooc = sum_preserve_na(analytical_urine_ooc),
    analytical_urine_ic = sum_preserve_na(analytical_urine_ic),
    analytical_urine_total = sum_preserve_na(analytical_urine_total),
    analytical_blood_ooc = sum_preserve_na(analytical_blood_ooc),
    analytical_blood_ic = sum_preserve_na(analytical_blood_ic),
    analytical_blood_total = sum_preserve_na(analytical_blood_total),
    analytical_dbs_ooc = sum_preserve_na(analytical_dbs_ooc),
    analytical_dbs_ic = sum_preserve_na(analytical_dbs_ic),
    analytical_dbs_total = sum_preserve_na(analytical_dbs_total),
    source_file = collapse_unique(source_file),
    source_year = first(source_year),
    source_report = collapse_unique(source_report),
    has_aaf_outcome_data = any_true(has_aaf_outcome_data),
    has_non_analytical_adrv_data = any_true(has_non_analytical_adrv_data),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(sport_clean = sport_join_name) %>%
  mutate(
    aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate = if_else(
      aaf_outcome_total > 0,
      analytical_adrv_count / aaf_outcome_total,
      NA_real_
    ),
    aaf_outcome_check =
      coalesce(medical_reasons_count, 0) +
      coalesce(no_case_to_answer_count, 0) +
      coalesce(no_sanction_count, 0) +
      coalesce(pending_count, 0) +
      coalesce(analytical_adrv_count, 0) -
      coalesce(aaf_outcome_total, 0),
    analytical_detail_vs_aaf_outcome_diff = if_else(
      !is.na(analytical_adrv_detail_count),
      analytical_adrv_detail_count - analytical_adrv_count,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Match check against Testing Figures by year + sport name.
testing_pairs <- testing %>%
  distinct(year, sport_clean) %>%
  mutate(testing_sport_match_same_year = TRUE)

adrv_cleaned <- adrv_cleaned %>%
  left_join(testing_pairs, by = c("year", "sport_clean")) %>%
  mutate(testing_sport_match_same_year = replace_na(testing_sport_match_same_year, FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    adrv_share_sport_allocated = total_adrv_count_sport_allocated /
      sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    analytical_adrv_share = analytical_adrv_count /
      sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated = non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated /
      sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    year,
    sport_clean,
    old_adrv_sport_names,
    n_adrv_source_rows,
    testing_sport_match_same_year,
    sport_raw_sources,
    sport_category_sources,
    source_tables,
    total_samples_aaf_outcome,
    aaf_outcome_total,
    medical_reasons_count,
    no_case_to_answer_count,
    no_sanction_count,
    pending_count,
    analytical_adrv_count,
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated,
    aaf_to_analytical_adrv_rate,
    adrv_share_sport_allocated,
    analytical_adrv_share,
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated,
    aaf_outcome_check,
    analytical_adrv_detail_count,
    analytical_detail_vs_aaf_outcome_diff,
    analytical_urine_ooc,
    analytical_urine_ic,
    analytical_urine_total,
    analytical_blood_ooc,
    analytical_blood_ic,
    analytical_blood_total,
    analytical_dbs_ooc,
    analytical_dbs_ic,
    analytical_dbs_total,
    source_file,
    source_year,
    source_report,
    has_aaf_outcome_data,
    has_non_analytical_adrv_data
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, desc(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated), sport_clean)


```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Audit files and validation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sport_name_crosswalk <- adrv_harmonised %>%
  distinct(year, sport_clean_original, sport_join_name, name_changed) %>%
  rename(sport_clean_final = sport_join_name) %>%
  arrange(year, sport_clean_original)

unmatched_after_cleaning <- adrv_cleaned %>%
  filter(!testing_sport_match_same_year)

validation_summary <- adrv_cleaned %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    unique_sports = n_distinct(sport_clean),
    aaf_outcome_total = sum(aaf_outcome_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    analytical_adrv_count = sum(analytical_adrv_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated = sum(non_analytical_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_adrv_count_sport_allocated = sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    adrv_share_sum = sum(adrv_share_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    analytical_adrv_share_sum = sum(analytical_adrv_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    non_analytical_adrv_share_sum = sum(non_analytical_adrv_share_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_not_matching_testing_same_year = sum(!testing_sport_match_same_year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    adrv_excluded_non_sport %>%
      group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(
        excluded_unknown_asp_total_adrvs = sum(total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    excluded_unknown_asp_total_adrvs = replace_na(excluded_unknown_asp_total_adrvs, 0),
    total_plus_excluded_unknown_asp = total_adrv_count_sport_allocated + excluded_unknown_asp_total_adrvs
  )

print(validation_summary)
print(unmatched_after_cleaning %>% select(year, sport_clean, old_adrv_sport_names, total_adrv_count_sport_allocated, aaf_outcome_total))
```
